name: web-e2e
// targets: to see all targets run: nx show project web-e2e --web

e2e.// dependsOn: @nx/playwright infers this from the `webServer` commands, and it only ever inferred half of it: `nx show project web-e2e --json` listed api:serve and nothing else, because `npx nx run web:start -- --port 4200` is not a string it can parse into a target. The web app was therefore built only as a side effect of Playwright spawning `web:start` itself — the arrangement that leaked a detached `next start` on every run (doc/decision/0285-*). Playwright now runs `next start` directly, so the build has to be spelled here. Both entries are listed because naming the key replaces the inferred array rather than adding to it.
